company.name: DataLexing
company.shortDescription: DataLexing is an AI native Work OS that automates workflows, reports, and reminders for teams, hosted in Saudi Arabia for compliance.
company.description: DataLexing, founded in 2018, is an AI native Work OS designed to think and act on behalf of teams. Built with agentic AI, it understands context, automates reporting, triggers reminders, and runs intelligent workflows to reduce manual coordination across tasks, data, and collaboration. DataLexing serves more than 20 government entities and 200 companies across 40 countries, with enterprise grade security and reliability. The platform is fully hosted in Saudi Arabia to support data sovereignty and compliance with National Cybersecurity Authority requirements, and holds SDAIA AI Service Provider accreditation, ISO IEC 27001 certification, and Google Zero Trust Key validation. It is also listed within the Mandatory List of National Products.
